description: Reg. § 1.453-12(d) Example 1: § 1250 property sold for $10,000 in ten equal annual installments; cost $5,000, straight-line depreciation $3,000; '$8000 of section 1231 gain ... $3000 is ... unrecaptured section 1250 gain. The gain on each installment payment is $800.' Table — Taxed at 25%: 800, 800, 800, 600; Remaining to be taxed at 25%: 2200, 1400, 600. Fifth year: 'The gain on A's remaining six installment payments is taxed at 20 percent' — no unrecaptured § 1250 gain is left.
